case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's central, quiet location, friendly and helpful staff, well-organized breakfast, cleanliness, comfortable beds and rooftop pool/bar with panoramic views. Reported negatives included small or slightly worn rooms, occasional breakfast coffee-machine failures, limited poolside space, malfunctioning lift call buttons, unexpected charges or procedures for the in-room safe and billiards, and communication lapses regarding picnic pickup and car-rental key handling.

priorities.area: Staff and service (car-rental key handling; paid-amenity communication)
priorities.recommendation: Review and standardise front-desk procedures/communications; train staff to disclose amenity charges pre-use and pickup details.
Inspect/maintain coffee-machines; add contingency and staff-checklist; clarify/document pickup with front-desk/bar teams for consistent checkout information.

priorities.area: Spa and pool (limited pool space / capacity)
priorities.recommendation: Assess rooftop-pool capacity and expectations; review layout, seating, peak-use; implement short-term steps; consider capital changes.
Implement standardized front-desk procedures, brief staff training, and signage/email clarifying picnic pickup, key custody, charges.
Request immediate elevator inspect/expedited-repair; service/replace coffee machine; open short-term tickets and create medium-term refurbishment plan.
Review ancillary fee presentation across channels, add clear signage, and consider making the safe complimentary.
